general.detail: The brief asks for high-confidence picks priced between -250 and +10000. A selection with a 70% chance prices at -233; anything at or above 70% therefore sits between -233 and -10000, and the overlap with a -250 floor is only 70.0%-71.4%. This desk publishes the true model price and marks band membership, rather than moving a line to manufacture compliant prices.
High, medium and low describe how far the model's probability sits from 50%. They are not strike rates, guarantees, or a claim that a price is a value bet.
No injury, lineup, suspension or player-scoring claim is made. Player-level facts were not read on an official page for these fixtures this pass.
Every price here is a fair, no-margin price computed as 1 / probability from the model. No bookmaker quote was read or compared.
